context: Replaces HttpClient's four-positional-argument constructor with a builder.
explanation: The old constructor took base_url, timeout_ms, retries, and user_agent as positional arguments - easy to mix up since timeout_ms and retries are both plain integers. HttpClientBuilder provides sensible defaults and named, chainable setters, so call sites read as HttpClientBuilder::new(url).retries(5).build() instead of guessing argument order, and future optional fields can be added without breaking existing callers.
